newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline climbs $1, Antwerp trades $184.50.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline climbs $1, Antwerp trades $184.50.

text.p: NWE gasoline firmed $1 a tonne on Monday morning, tracking higher crude oil.
Antwerp barges traded at $184.50 fob while running Rotterdam refinery product talked $188.
"Nothing has changed fundamentally but the cracks have improved a bit and some people like the U.S. makret," said a trader.
Swaps were also a touched firmer talking $185.50 for July and 75 cents to $1 lower for August.
Regular barges talked $178 fob Rotterdam but were untraded by mid-morning.
